ptransfer.title: Move or share patients to another clinic
ptransfer.lead: For a doctor with more than one clinic: the chosen patients' whole files go to the other clinic — straight from this clinic's database to the other's.
ptransfer.history_lead: Patients moved or shared between your clinics, and updates of shared patients.
ptransfer.no_targets_text: When you open your other clinic (as its owner), it appears here and patients can be moved or shared to it.
ptransfer.none_chosen: No patients chosen. Tick them in the patient list (or use a filter such as a group), then choose “Move / share”.
ptransfer.share: Share — the patient is in both clinics
ptransfer.share_text: The patient can visit here or at {clinic}. Both files are linked, and each clinic can pull what the other added (“Update”).
ptransfer.move: Move — the patient continues at the other clinic
ptransfer.move_text: The file goes to {clinic}. Here it stays as a read-only archive (hidden from the list) that can be brought back.
ptransfer.doctor_same: The doctor with the same name (automatic)
ptransfer.doctor_help: Visits of a doctor that has no one with the same name there go to this doctor.
ptransfer.rule_all: Everything goes: details, visits with notes and diagnoses, prescriptions, tests, referrals, dental chart, forms, files, X-rays, groups, photo and the old system's records.
ptransfer.rule_twice: A patient already there (national ID, or the same name and phone) is completed, not duplicated; doing it again adds nothing twice.
ptransfer.rule_future: Upcoming bookings stay where they were booked (the result says how many).
ptransfer.rule_money: Invoices are not re-created there: their PDF is added to the patient's files.
ptransfer.started: The transfer has started; it runs in the background.
ptransfer.future_note: {n} upcoming bookings stay at {clinic} — move them by hand if needed.
ptransfer.shared_sub: Pull what your other clinic added for the patients you share with it.
ptransfer.moved_text: Moved on {date}. This file is kept here as an archive.
ptransfer.restore_confirm: Bring this patient back into this clinic's patient list? The copy in the other clinic stays.
ptransfer.restored: The patient is back in the list.

err.TRANSFER_TARGET: Choose one of your other clinics.
err.TRANSFER_EMPTY: Choose at least one patient (not already moved).
err.TRANSFER_TOO_MANY: Too many patients at once (at most 5,000).
err.STORAGE_FULL: The receiving clinic's file storage is full; raise it, then try again.
err.PERMISSION_DENIED: You no longer manage the data of both clinics.
